onboard.frontierhunts.step.3.p2: To put a head on an arrow, go to the Reloading Bench. On its Arrows tab, make new arrows with the head you want, like Hunting Arrow · Field Point (a stick, a feather and four heads; missing heads are made from your materials). On its Fit arrowheads tab, put new heads on arrows you already have: pick the stack, click a head, press Fit all. The old heads come back.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.tips.card: Reloading Bench: make Hunting Arrow · Field Point on the Arrows tab, or fit field points on the Fit arrowheads tab.
onboard.frontierhunts.task.tips.how: At the Reloading Bench, make Hunting Arrow · Field Point on the Arrows tab, or make field points on Arrow tips and fit them to your arrows on Fit arrowheads.
